mapper.insert: INSERT INTO solutions (task_id, description) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{description}) ON CONFLICT (task_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM solution_files WHERE solution_id = #{solutionId} AND file_id = #{fileId}
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.original_name, f.content_type FROM course_files f JOIN solution_files link ON link.file_id = f.id WHERE link.solution_id = #{solutionId} ORDER BY f.id
